summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X ETF (CSCL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Cisco Systems, Inc. CSCL was launched on Jun 25, 2025 and is issued by Direxion.

holdings.infoBox: CSCL is an equity ETF with a total of 10 individual holdings.
